entries.proposition: NOT a dose-response: clemastine at one stated dose, given P21 to P58, i.e. after the knockout at P10-12 and after weaning, not in the infant window.
entries.snippet: clemastine fumarate (10 mg/kg), a first-generation antihistamine with established remyelination-promoting effects, was administered once daily from P21 to P58

entries.proposition: The model is an OPC-lineage kinase knockout induced at P10-12; the constitutive version had seizures and death before P21 and was not rescued here.
entries.snippet: In contrast to the constitutive Pdk1 cKO mouse model (Pdk1fl/fl;Olig1-Cre) [22], Pdk1 icKO mice remained viable and did not exhibit spontaneous seizures or early lethality.
entries.anchor: Results / Postnatal PDK1 deletion impairs OPC differentiation

entries.proposition: The authors report that the constitutive model had severe seizures from P14; this paper does not test clemastine there.
entries.snippet: it displayed severe spontaneous seizures starting at P14 and early lethality by P21

entries.proposition: Hippocampal MBP, TrueGold area and Olig2, CC1 and ASPA counts rise with clemastine in the knockout.
entries.snippet: MBP immunostaining demonstrated markedly enhanced signal intensity in clemastine-treated Pdk1 icKO mice relative to saline-treated controls (Fig. 4F and G).

entries.proposition: Fig 4 legend: Olig2 n = 3 per group, ASPA 3-4, MBP 5; the TrueGold legend gives P as ** and "p < 0.001".
entries.snippet: Data are presented as mean ± SEM (n = 3 per group; ∗∗, p < 0.01).

entries.proposition: Hyperexcitability is not measured; neuronal activity is read as c-Fos-positive cell counts after behavioural testing and, in the knockout without treatment, as mEPSC amplitude and frequency from n = 3 animals.
entries.snippet: Data are presented as mean ± SEM (n = 3 per genotype; ∗∗, p < 0.01).

entries.proposition: Clemastine effect on c-Fos is read as restored neuronal activation, a count of immediate-early-gene positive cells 60 min after behaviour.
entries.snippet: To further assess neuronal activity in vivo, hippocampal tissues were collected from mice 60 min following behavioral testing.
entries.anchor: Results / Deletion of PDK1 impairs synaptogenesis

entries.proposition: The treated-control arm: clemastine did not alter VGlut1 puncta in control mice, the only evidence on a normal-brain effect in the paper.
entries.snippet: Notably, clemastine treatment did not significantly alter VGlut1+ puncta density in control mice, indicating that its effect was specific to the pathological condition (Fig. 5A and B).

entries.proposition: Gliosis: GFAP area is unchanged in the knockout, so astrocytic gliosis is not a phenotype of this model and was not a treatment target.
entries.snippet: No significant difference in GFAP expression was observed between genotypes.

entries.proposition: No safety, exposure, body weight, sedation or histamine-related measure is reported for clemastine; the Discussion relies on an established-safety statement.
entries.snippet: Clemastine, an FDA-approved antihistamine with established clinical safety, has recently emerged as a potent promoter of OL differentiation and myelination

entries.proposition: Mechanism: clemastine restores Akt T308 and S6 phosphorylation; the muscarinic M1 antagonism route is named as an unexplored alternative.
entries.snippet: Interestingly, clemastine has been reported to exert pro-myelination effects through antagonism of muscarinic receptor 1 (M1R) [59,60], raising the possibility of crosstalk

entries.proposition: Tamoxifen was given at 50 mg/kg for three days; no tamoxifen-treated Cre-negative or CreERT2-only control is described (controls are Pdk1 fl/fl littermates).
entries.snippet: Littermate Pdk1fl/fl mice were used as controls.

entries.snippet: Control: g-ratio = 0.77896741; Pdk1 icKO: g-ratio = 0.858915
